sentence: I stopped ___ because the doctor told me to.
explanation: <Stop> + gerundio = detener una actividad de forma permanente. He stopped smoking = dejó de fumar.
tip: stop + -ing = quit the activity

sentence: I stopped ___ some water because I was thirsty.
explanation: <Stop> + infinitivo = pausar una actividad para hacer otra. I stopped to drink = me detuve para tomar agua.
tip: stop + to = pause to do something else

sentence: I remember ___ the door before I left.
explanation: <Remember> + gerundio = recordar algo que hiciste en el pasado.
tip: remember + -ing = memory of a past action

sentence: Please remember ___ the door when you leave.
explanation: <Remember> + infinitivo = no olvidar hacer algo en el futuro.
tip: remember + to = don't forget a future action

sentence: I tried ___ the window, but it was stuck.
explanation: <Try> + infinitivo = intentar hacer algo difícil.
tip: try + to = attempt with effort

sentence: I tried ___ the window to let some air in.
explanation: <Try> + gerundio = experimentar con un método o solución.
tip: try + -ing = experiment with a method

sentence: She forgot ___ her mother on her birthday.
explanation: <Forget> + infinitivo = no lograr hacer algo que debías hacer.
tip: forget + to = fail to do something

sentence: I'll never forget ___ the Northern Lights.
explanation: <Forget> + gerundio = no olvidar una experiencia o recuerdo pasado.
tip: forget + -ing = a memorable past experience

sentence: I regret ___ you that the position has been filled.
explanation: <Regret> + infinitivo = lamentar lo que estás a punto de decir (formal).
tip: regret + to = sorry to say (formal announcement)

sentence: She regrets ___ school so young.
explanation: <Regret> + gerundio = lamentar algo que hiciste en el pasado.
tip: regret + -ing = sorry about a past action

sentence: He went on ___ about his holiday for hours.
explanation: <Go on> + gerundio = continuar con la misma actividad.
tip: go on + -ing = continue the same thing

sentence: After the introduction, she went on ___ the main results.
explanation: <Go on> + infinitivo = pasar a la siguiente actividad o tema.
tip: go on + to = move to the next thing

sentence: Being a doctor means ___ long hours.
explanation: <Mean> + gerundio = implicar o tener como resultado algo.
tip: mean + -ing = involve / result in

sentence: I didn't mean ___ your feelings.
explanation: <Mean> + infinitivo = tener la intención de hacer algo.
tip: mean + to = intend

sentence: On the way home, we stopped ___ petrol.
explanation: <Stop> + infinitivo = detenerse para hacer algo. We stopped to get petrol = nos detuvimos para cargar gasolina.
tip: stop + to = pause for a purpose

sentence: Do you remember ___ this song at school?
explanation: <Remember> + gerundio = tener el recuerdo de haber hecho algo.
tip: remember + -ing = recall a past experience

sentence: You must remember ___ your passport.
explanation: <Remember> + infinitivo = no olvidar una obligación futura.
tip: remember + to = don't forget to do it

sentence: If the computer crashes, try ___ it off and on again.
explanation: <Try> + gerundio = experimentar con una posible solución.
tip: try + -ing = test a method

sentence: I'll never forget ___ my first car.
explanation: <Forget> + gerundio = una experiencia pasada memorable que no olvidarás.
tip: forget + -ing = unforgettable memory

sentence: Don't forget ___ the lights before bed.
explanation: <Forget> + infinitivo = no lograr recordar una tarea.
tip: forget + to = remember to do it
